notes.title: PAX/EGX live stream
notes.notes:
Guild of Darksteel is a cinematic, side-scrolling adventure set in a lush, layered dark fantasy world.
Embark on a dark fantasy adventure and follow the Sellsword, an immortal, as he seeks a purpose in eternal life by joining the Guild of Darksteel. Become one of their immortal mercenaries and investigate the mysterious tunnels underneath the cities of Ravenrock.

Join the Digerati discord - https://discord.gg/JtSw6t

notes.title: Guild of Darksteel – play the demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Good news – a demo for Guild of Darksteel is now live! [/b]You can download it from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356580/Guild_of_Darksteel/]Store page[/url][/b] – look for the green 'Download Guild of Darksteel Demo' widget and press the 'Download' button. The demo is live for a limited time, although it will be accessible for the entire duration of the PAX X EGX event, which runs from 12-20 September. 

There are a couple of missions to get through in the demo, which represents a decent slice of game time. Playing as the immortal sellsword protagonist, you'll be able to explore areas of Ravenrock and discover a little about the game's story by meeting some of the gothic city's residents. Enemy encounters will give you the opportunity to try out the combat system and start stringing together combos.

As well as launching the demo, we've also put together a new Guild of Darksteel trailer to announce that, in addition to Steam, the game will also be launching on PS4 and Switch:

[previewyoutube=wXyUfwgHCyw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you try the demo, feel free to drop us a comment with any feedback. And don’t forget to [b]add Guild of Darksteel to your wishlist[/b] and/or give the game a ‘Follow’. All support is really appreciated.

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356580/Guild_of_Darksteel/

notes.title: Guild of Darksteel - A cinematic dark fantasy epic!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Steam page for Guild of Darksteel – a brand-new game from artist and one-man studio, Igor Sandman. An epic cinematic adventure set in a rich dark fantasy world, Guild of Darksteel will launch later this year. You can find full details, along with some screenshots and trailers, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356580/Guild_of_Darksteel/]on the game page[/url][/b] - give it a follow and add it to your wishlist, and we’ll keep you in mind when the game proceeds to beta in the near future!

A side scrolling adventure that claims influences as storied and diverse as both Flashback and Vagrant Story, Guild of Darksteel is a truly unique gameplay experience. Combining classic cinematic platformer gameplay with a deceptively robust combat system, Guild of Darksteel has something to offer to gamers of all stripes - it’s a truly fantastic storytelling experience, and we’re looking forward to showing you more in the coming weeks!

Guild of Darksteel is the product of artist Igor Sandman. Igor has an extensive background in film and television production, and worked as an animator on the strategy card game, Faeria. While Guild of Darksteel is Igor’s first solo production, it serves as a real showcase of the breadth of his abilities - we’re excited to show the world what he can do!

The link below will take you to the main page for Guild of Darksteel, where you can get the latest and greatest.  Again, if you like what you see, give the game a follow and add it to your wishlist while you’re there - your support is always appreciated!  

Steve | Digerati
